settings.q: Can you build a cutaway of my specific design?
settings.a: Yes. Send your drawings or CAD files and we'll build an accurate sectioned model to your chosen scale.

settings.q: Can you include interiors and landscaping?
settings.a: Yes - interior layouts, furniture, pools, greenery and finishes can all be modelled to the level of detail you need.
Yes, interior and feature lighting can be built in to highlight spaces during presentations.

settings.hero_desc: A cutaway architectural model that opens the building up - showing the internal layout, levels, pools and landscaping in a single sectioned view. The clearest way to explain a design's flow and volumes to clients, buyers and stakeholders.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your building design, scale, materials palette and base branding
settings.s1_body: A section-view model cuts the building open so everyone can read it at a glance - how the floors stack, how spaces connect, where the pool and landscaping sit. Built to scale from your drawings and finished by hand with realistic materials and greenery, it turns a complex design into something a client understands instantly. Ideal for presentations, approvals and sales galleries.
settings.case_body: Built as a presentation model for an architect, this cutaway let the design team walk clients straight through the scheme - levels, spaces and landscaping all legible at once - and settled questions that drawings alone left open.
settings.case_quote: The section view answered every client question instantly. They understood the whole design in seconds.
settings.prov_p: A cutaway model communicates spatial relationships that drawings and renders struggle to convey. Seeing a building in section, in three dimensions, is the fastest way to build understanding and confidence. The design, laid open.
